meta_title: The BIG Blue Hat Gardening | Garden Services Nottingham
meta_description: The BIG Blue Hat Gardening brings professional garden care to Nottingham. From lawn maintenance to landscaping, we keep your outdoor space thriving year-round.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Garden Care — Nottingham & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning landscaping, The BIG Blue Hat transforms Nottingham gardens into outdoor spaces you'll love.
services_subhead: Whether you need regular maintenance, a full redesign, or seasonal preparation, we handle every aspect of garden care.

services.title: Lawn Mowing & Care
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly grass cutting with aeration and scarification to keep your lawn thick and healthy. We tailored schedules to your needs and the season.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.desc: Expert pruning and shaping of hedges, shrubs, and climbers. We tidy overgrown borders and promote healthy new growth, keeping your garden looking neat.

services.title: Garden Landscaping
services.desc: Full garden redesigns including raised beds, pathways, patios, and planting schemes. We turn tired outdoor spaces into stunning rooms for living and entertaining.

services.title: Seasonal Tidying
services.desc: Spring clean-ups, autumn leaf clearing, and winter prep. We remove debris, dead wood, and weeds so your garden looks its best all year.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Professional planting advice and installation of perennials, annuals, and shrubs. We design colour schemes that suit your Nottingham home and bloom throughout the year.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Swift removal of overgrown vegetation, old structures, and garden waste. Ideal for project gardens or properties where nature has taken over.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden like it's our own backyard.
about_para_1: The BIG Blue Hat Gardening was founded on a simple idea: Nottingham gardens deserve care from people who genuinely love outdoor spaces. With over a decade of experience, we've grown from a solo operator into a trusted local team. We specialise in transforming neglected gardens and maintaining stunning ones, working across Nottingham and the surrounding areas.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability, attention to detail, and fair pricing. We listen to what our customers want, deliver on time, and stand behind our work. Whether you need a one-off tidy or ongoing maintenance, we're here to make garden care easy and stress-free.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: The lads have been coming every fortnight for two years now. Garden always looks immaculate, they're friendly, and they turn up when they say they will. Can't recommend them highly enough.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had a complete garden redesign done last summer. From start to finish, brilliant communication and the finished result is even better than I imagined. We use them for maintenance now too.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Cleared an absolutely overgrown jungle of a garden that we'd neglected for three years. They worked through it methodically, removed everything safely, and left the garden ready for a fresh start. Honest pricing too.
reviews.author: Mark J.
